description: Record an accepted risk on a program, initiative or work item. A risk NEVER blocks: it does not change status or dispatchability, is not a dependency and does not touch the critical path. Requires an owner (defaults to you) and either `reviewBy` or `acceptedUntilMilestoneId`. Requires `write` scope.

acceptedUntilMilestoneId.description: Program milestone id the risk is accepted until.

followUpWorkItemIds.description: Work items that will retire the risk.

ownerUid.description: Owner user id. Defaults to the key holder.

reviewBy.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD the risk must be reviewed again.

subjectId.description: Program, initiative or work item id.

subjectKind.description: What the risk is attached to.

title.description: Short statement of the accepted risk.

trigger.description: The condition under which this becomes a real problem.

name: anyforge_create_risk
title: Create risk
